81987.subject: Anthropic can sell more AI than it can supply, & that’s now the biggest risk to its $1.5T IPO 🤖📉; Shopify’s Q3 2…
81987.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1148

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re breaking down Anthropic’s amended IPO filing, which shows the AI giant can now sell more AI than it can supply (why a $5B short-term compute bill flipped Q3 to a loss, which of our 3 warning signs has already tripped before ANT even lists, how a SpaceX contract with a 90-day exit ties into it, whether $1.5T still works, & what’s next + bonus dive into Y Combinator, Which Just Showed You What to Build Right Now [ https://substack.com/redirect/c850cec1-6fe1-4517-8abc-80c27dda2a02?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Top 10 Stocks Positioned to Benefit The Most from Anthropic IPO [ https://substack.com/redirect/250ea04b-8475-42ea-9beb-5a9a60a743e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving deep into Shopify’s Q3 2026 earnings (why the 66% profit jump is really 40%, why the stock fell 9% on a rounding-error miss, how Shop Pay just moved inside other companies’ AI agents, & what to watch next + bonus deep dives into After the Click: The Playbook for the New Internet Era [ https://substack.com/redirect/5dc90ad3-957b-4792-9754-f0f7c41d7d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Run a One-Person Company on Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/bcd63b14-66ca-4085-ad60-f0bb020bd05f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the interesting stuff 🌶️
Anthropic can sell more AI than it can supply, and that’s now the biggest risk to its $1.5 trillion IPO 🤖📉
Following the money 💸 A week ago, our Anthropic IPO deep dive [ https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc1ca-8481-42cd-9599-fcb1f8928ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] said a $1.5 trillion valuation rested on a third-quarter revenue figure Anthropic hadn’t disclosed yet. The amended S-1, filed on November 2, finally discloses it, and Q3 2026 revenue came in at nearly $17 billion. Not bad, maybe? 👀
Well, the same filing shows Anthropic swinging from a $974 million operating profit to a $567 million loss, with compute climbing to 58% of revenue. It also lays out $895.4 billion of compute commitments in full for the first time. Put simply, revenue landed where our model needed it. Costs did not 🤷‍♂️
Let’s take a closer look at this and rerun our valuation model [ https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc1ca-8481-42cd-9599-fcb1f8928ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] against the new filing to see whether $1.5 trillion still works, now that investors are asking for $1.4 trillion to $1.6 trillion. We’ll go through which of our three warning signs [ https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc1ca-8481-42cd-9599-fcb1f8928ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] has already tripped before ANT even lists on Na
